name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-06-11, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.24 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
